_doc: Mentor character for every shot. Swap the mentor by editing this file only (or sb.html?mentor=<other.json>). Shots ask for SEMANTIC clips/faces (left side of clip_map / eyes_map / mouth_map); a missing key falls back to the same name. face_lists = the atlas cells per face material (cell k = column k % cols, row k // cols); without face_lists the model's face_tracks.json _meta is used.
name: Pip
unit_note: height_m scales the bind-pose bounding box; origin = feet
